definition: A place or feature that draws interest, visitors, or admiration
examples: The Eiffel Tower is a popular tourist attraction.

definition: To break free from confinement, control, or a difficult situation
examples: They wanted to escape the hustle and bustle of the city for the weekend.

definition: A spring producing water that naturally contains dissolved mineral salts or gases
examples: People visit the town to relax in its famous natural mineral springs.

definition: Visually attractive, especially in a quaint or charming way
examples: We stayed in a picturesque village surrounded by mountains.

definition: To advise or suggest something as a good or suitable choice
examples: Can you recommend a good restaurant near the hotel?

definition: A place frequented for holidays, recreation, or relaxation
examples: They spent their summer vacation at a seaside resort in Spain.

definition: A weather condition characteristic of the tropics, hot and moist year-round
examples: The island has a warm tropical climate that attracts tourists all year.

definition: A slide at a swimming pool or water park down which people slide into water
examples: The children had fun sliding down the huge waterslide.

definition: Enjoyable, useful, or rewarding enough to justify the cost, effort, or time spent
examples: The hike up the mountain was exhausting, but the view made it worth it.

definition: An organization or person that transmits radio or television programs
examples: The BBC is a major national broadcaster in the UK.

definition: The ceremony of crowning a king, queen, or other monarch
examples: Millions of people watched the king's coronation on live television.

definition: Events or political items of social interest and importance that are happening in the world at the present time
examples: She watches the news every evening to stay informed about current affairs.

definition: To establish or originate an institution, organization, or town
examples: The company was founded in 1995 by two university students.

definition: The characteristics, qualities, or beliefs that define who a person or group is
examples: Cultural traditions help preserve a nation's identity.

definition: A large body of people united by common descent, history, culture, or language, inhabiting a particular territory
examples: Representatives from over one hundred nations attended the conference.

definition: A spoken, written, or broadcast story giving information about current events
examples: The morning news report covered the storm that struck the coast.

definition: A place, person, or thing from which something originates or can be obtained
examples: The journalist refused to reveal the identity of her source.

definition: Regarded as reliable, honest, and dependable
examples: He is a trusted colleague who always delivers on his promises.

definition: To make or become united, whole, or uniform
examples: The leader worked hard to unify the divided country.

definition: A particular feature, part, or side of something
examples: We need to consider every aspect of the problem before deciding.

definition: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the origin of something
examples: The proud parents celebrated the birth of their first child.

definition: An activity involving skill in making things by hand
examples: Traditional pottery is a craft that requires years of practice.

definition: A hole dug in the ground to receive a dead body
examples: Family members placed flowers on the grave every anniversary.

definition: The action of introducing something, or the opening section of a book or speech
examples: Read the introduction to get an overview of the topic.

definition: To cause a person or group to go with one by guiding or preceding them
examples: She was chosen to lead the expedition through the mountains.

definition: The person who leads, commands, or heads a group, organization, or country
examples: A good leader listens to the opinions of team members.

definition: An amount of money or property left to someone in a will, or a long-lasting impact from the past
examples: The artist left a rich legacy of paintings and sculptures.

definition: A group of musicians who play instruments while marching, often in a parade
examples: The marching band performed during halftime at the football game.

definition: The elected head of a city, town, or other municipality
examples: The mayor gave a speech at the opening ceremony of the new park.

definition: A member of a group of people who move from place to place rather than living in one fixed location
examples: The traditional nomads moved across the steppe in search of pasture for their livestock.

definition: A public procession, especially one celebrating a special day or event
examples: Thousands of people lined the streets to watch the annual holiday parade.

definition: A person who writes plays for the theater
examples: William Shakespeare is one of the most famous playwrights in history.

definition: To be a symbol of or represent something
examples: The white dove is often used to symbolise peace.

definition: A circular tent made of felt or skins on a collapsible framework, traditionally used by nomads in Central Asia
examples: They stayed in a traditional yurt while visiting Central Asia.

definition: An electrical impulse or gesture used to convey information or instructions
examples: The nerve carries an electrical signal from the inner ear to the brain.

definition: The hard, spiral outer casing of a snail
examples: The cochlea in the inner ear resembles a tiny coiled snail shell.

definition: A tiny bone in the middle ear (stapes) that transmits sound vibrations to the inner ear
examples: The stirrup is the smallest bone in the human body.

definition: A long, hollow cylinder used to carry fluids, air, or sound
examples: Sound waves pass through a narrow tube in the ear to reach the eardrum.

definition: To move continuously and rapidly to and fro
examples: Loud sound waves cause the eardrum to vibrate rapidly.

definition: A disturbance that travels through a medium, carrying energy such as sound or light
examples: Sound waves travel through the air into your ear canal.

definition: A large number of people gathered together in one place
examples: A huge crowd gathered in the main square to watch the concert.

definition: A feeling of great excitement, energy, and tension among a group of people
examples: There was an electric atmosphere in the stadium just before the match began.

definition: Extremely tired, completely drained of physical or mental energy
examples: After working all day without a break, she felt completely exhausted.

definition: A combination of different elements, qualities, or ingredients
examples: The event was an exciting mixture of music, dancing, and great food.

definition: In a manner that shows willingness to wait without getting annoyed or upset
examples: The fans waited patiently in line for hours to meet the author.

definition: To present a form of entertainment, such as music or theater, to an audience
examples: The orchestra will perform live at the concert hall tonight.

definition: A group of people with common experiences or concerns who meet to encourage and help each other
examples: Joining a support group helped her manage stress more effectively.
